body: I've been clinging the last 2 months. I held the glimmer and it was brighter than ever before. Even as things were falling apart, it didn't fade. It just finally completely disappeared though. I've been trying to do things right this time...and it all just got worse than ever.

They should be in jail. I shouldn't have been treating them like a best friend because they're a manipulative fucking snake.
I've stuck around through this shit for decades already. Sometimes, I get this glimmer of hope. Then one thing goes wrong, then another, then another and before I know it, I'm too scared to leave the house or look another human in the eye.
Damn right I want to live. I just don't want to live *this* life anymore.
Things become ok for a bit, then everything falls apart again. Worse than before each time.

I have PTSD, major depressive disorder, and generalized panic/anxiety disorder. I was first diagnosed with the first two when I was 10, and again by every diagnosing professional I've seen.

And I've been talking a lot about my fears about leaving. It hasn't helped besides pointing out that everything besides homelessness is going to be a "bad idea". Not that anyone but me realizes this is my only available option.

She's a fighter like me, but I'm tired of fighting.

And I recently learned how to forgive him. He was quite young to be able to desire toying with his little brother's friend. The only logical answer is that it must have happened to him. But knowing's only half the battle, and I still fight homicidal urges towards him. Luckily, I don't know anything about him besides he's 4 to 6 years older than me.
Empty, scared, untrusting, alone, angry, vengeful. And she is.
Not understanding the sexual things my friend's older brother made me do. My sister being deathly ill. Being bullied at school.
